text:
Marta: quick thread: findings from yesterday's soft-reserve heap experiment + followups
Diego: nice, TL;DR?
Marta: p95 improved slightly (~60ms) but memory churn increased and we saw KV warmups spike
Yumi: are soft-reserves basically prefetches that hold tiny state?
Marta: yeah: small reservation object allocated, doesn't consume admission credit until confirmed
Chris: tradeoff obvious: higher chance to coalesce vs extra mem + temp kvcache pressure
Diego: how did we bound concurrent soft-reserves per-tenant?
Marta: we used tenant_soft_limit=8 + global_soft_pool=512, LRU eviction on heap
Yumi: did we track reservation->confirm ratio?
Marta: confirm_rate ~ 0.42 on canary, so majority canceled and freed quickly
Chris: that explains memory churn. maybe need stronger heuristics for issuing soft-reserves
Diego: what heuristics? RTT hints? seq_length predictions? historical coalesce probability?
Yumi: simplest: only issue soft-reserve if recent_coalesce_rate > 0.5 for tenant and client_rtt < 200ms
Marta: we tried client_rtt gating in a small subset; confirm_rate rose to 0.63 but tail improved more
Chris: another idea: make soft-reserve cheap stateless token (no KV pin) and perform async KV warm on confirmation path only
Diego: but async KV warm adds latency for confirmed joins, hurting p50
Marta: right. tradeoffs. alternative: staged warm: lightweight bloom-check for prefix presence then full warm
Yumi: can we amortize cost across replicas? if multiple requests from same tenant hit different shards, bloom helps
Chris: bloom requires sync of small metadata; operational cost but doable
Diego: eviction interaction: many canceled soft-reserves triggered eviction heuristics because they left behind partial kvcache entries
Marta: fix: differentiate ephemeral warm entries with TTL and lower eviction priority
Yumi: runtime state machine proposal (pseudo):
```
state = IDLE
on_request:
  if can_soft_reserve(tenant): state=SOFT_RESERVED; emit reservation_id
on_soft_reserve_timeout:
  if occupancy >= threshold: state=CONFIRMED; grant admission_credit
  else: state=IDLE; maybe ban(tenant) backoff
on_confirm_eviction:
  state=EVICTED; apply eviction_backoff
```
Chris: note: ban/backoff needs fairness ledger update else gaming possible
Diego: add fairness rule: soft-reserve attempts count as fractional "soft_credits" with diminishing returns in accounting
Yumi: also add escape hatch: route-level QoS that bypasses soft-reserve limits for explicit SLO routes
Marta: telemetry list for RFC: soft_reserve_attempts, soft_reserve_confirms, soft_reserve_memory_bytes, kvcache_ephemeral_count, tenant_soft_backoff, bloom_miss_rate
Chris: rollout plan: feature-flag, canary 2 shards x 48h, then 10% for 24h, monitor p95/p99, mem, and kvcache_evictions
Diego: alerts: mem_increase>15% OR kvcache_ephemeral_count>baseline*2 -> rollback
Yumi: long-term: ML model that predicts join probability at arrival based on prefix features and client signals; use for adaptive soft_reserve issuance
Marta: agreed. for RFC I'll include API for telemetry, the pseudo-state machine, fairness accounting changes, and a short ops checklist
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled to shard-c with feature soft_reserve_heap=true
Chris: thanks, I'll review RFC draft and sanity-check thresholds :thumbsup:
